1. 2,500W+ GPU Two-Phase Hazards & Legacy Limits
A. Critical Heat Flux (CHF) Vapor-Blanket Dry-Out
• 180 W/cm² AI GPU hotspot drives exit vapor quality x = 0.89
• Above x > 0.75 CHF limit, liquid wetting film evaporates completely
• Heat transfer drops 90% → GPU Tj spikes +38°C/s (burnout <300ms)
✗ 5-second BMS polling cannot stop sub-second HBM4/GPU destruction
B. Parallel-Manifold Ledinegg Flow Starvation
• Negative-slope ∂ΔP/∂G < 0 on two-phase demand curve
• Hot Rack-84 ColdPlate-12 loses refrigerant flow to cooler neighbors
• 4.5 Hz density-wave oscillation accelerates CHF dry-out cascade
✗ Requires 15ms piezo-inlet orifice ΔP throttling + +18 kPa subcooling
